key_insight: Deterministically optimized twirling sequences shape coherent-error trajectories to keep accumulated error bounded at O(1), versus O(√N) scaling for randomized compiling.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects pulse-level robust control with circuit compilation to suppress coherent errors without logical encoding or ancillary qubits.
method: Map discrete circuit-error accumulation into trajectories in a high-dimensional error space.
Optimize twirling gate sequences to induce destructive interference between errors.
Combine circuit-level correction with pulse-level robust control.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports bounded O(1) error scaling and an analytical bridge between pulse and circuit dynamics, but provides no numerical benchmarks or hardware-validation details.
watch_item: Practical benefits require validation under realistic noise and the added implementation cost of twirling gates.
paper_title: Bridging Pulse and Circuit Levels: A Geometric Framework for Deterministic Error Suppression
